crossRefs.note: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
“Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I…
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he…
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you…
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.
Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

parallels.note: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

translations.web: You will save the afflicted people, But your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
translations.bsb: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
translations.kjv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
translations.asv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save; But thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
